description.zh-CN: 默认跟随「设置 → 模型 → OCR」里的引擎。设备自带识别横排界面文字最快；竖排要用本地模型；Google Lens 会上传整张截图。跟随的本地模型还没下载时先用设备自带。

description.en: After allowing screen recording once, screen OCR stops showing the system confirmation every time
description.zh-CN: 同意一次录屏后，之后截屏识字不再每次弹系统确认框

description.en: Keeps the last 60 seconds of sound played by other apps in memory (Android 10+). Cards mined from out-of-app lookups get the voice line from just before the lookup as sentence audio. Some games block capture and record silence.
description.zh-CN: 在内存里循环保留其他应用最近 60 秒的声音（Android 10 及以上）。应用外查词制卡时，把查词前最后一句语音作为句子音频放进卡片。部分游戏禁止被录音，录到的是静音。

description.en: Keep the previous and next chapters loaded so scrolling flows across chapter boundaries without reloading
